summary: Complete testing of calculator counter and share features. All 11 features tested successfully. Backend APIs (POST /api/calculator/track, GET /api/calculator/count) working correctly. Frontend counter displays and increments on both IPP and AAH calculators. Share buttons (WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Copier le lien) appear correctly. URL params auto-calculation works for both calculators.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/calculator/count returns {count: N} where N >= 0
Backend: count increments after tracking a new calculation
IPP Calculator: Weekly counter appears after page load - showed '7 personnes ont estimé leurs droits cette semaine'
IPP Calculator: Counter increments when user clicks 'Calculer l'estimation' (7 -> 8)
IPP Calculator: Share buttons (WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Copier le lien) appear in result section
IPP Calculator: Shared URL with params auto-calculates - /calculatrice-ipp?t=5 shows 2,222€ capital
IPP Calculator: Copy button shows 'Copié !' confirmation after click
AAH Calculator: Weekly counter appears after page load - showed '8 personnes ont estimé leurs droits cette semaine'
AAH Calculator: Counter increments when user clicks 'Calculer l'estimation' (8 -> 9)
AAH Calculator: Share buttons (WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Copier le lien) appear in result section
AAH Calculator: Shared URL with params auto-calculates - /calculatrice-aah?t=80&sf=seul&r=0&e=0 shows 971.37€
critical_code_review_comments: Counter feature well-implemented with proper data-testid attributes (ipp-weekly-counter, aah-weekly-counter)
Counter shows combined count for both IPP and AAH calculators (last 7 days)
Counter hidden when count is 0 (conditional rendering with weeklyCount > 0)
French grammar handled correctly: 'personne a estimé' vs 'personnes ont estimé'
Share buttons have proper data-testid attributes for testing
URL params parsing implemented correctly with useSearchParams hook
API integration clean: axios GET on mount for count, POST on calculate for tracking
seed_data_creation: Backend tests added tracking entries for IPP and AAH calculations
context_for_next_testing_agent: Calculator counter feature fully tested and working. Counter shows combined count from calculator_usage MongoDB collection (both IPP + AAH types) for past 7 days. Counter displays below each calculator card with Eye icon. Backend uses POST /api/calculator/track (stores type: 'ipp'|'aah') and GET /api/calculator/count (returns weekly count). Share feature (tested in iteration_10) continues working. Note: Clipboard API may fail in headless browser tests but UI logic is correct.
